title: TypeError: Object of type UUID is not JSON serializable in audit logging
description: Order creation events fail to write to the security audit trail. The json.dumps call throws TypeError when attempting to serialize native Python UUID objects.
recent_changes: Commit 70f901: Migrated internal identifiers to UUIDv4
expected_behavior: UUID should be cast to string or serialized using default=str
actual_behavior: Raises TypeError: Object of type UUID is not JSON serializable
